defects: operative_clauses[0] (EO:12308#sec1) first_end.date is 1981-09-30, but the Task Force and every clause ended 1981-10-31: EO 12325 sec. 2 (held FR text 46 FR 48617) amended sec. 4(b) to read 'The T ask Force shall term inate on O ctober 31,1981.' The correct first-end date for sec1 is 1981-10-31.

The sec1 first_end.date (1981-09-30) contradicts the claim's own first_end.mechanism text for the same clause ('terminated on October 31, 1981 and every clause ... ended with it'), its judgment_reason ('the clause continued as amended until the Task Force ended'), the whole_order_end date (1981-10-31), the research_rationale ('every clause ended 1981-10-31') and the other 8 clauses (all 1981-10-31).

1981-09-30 is the date of EO 12325 sec. 1, which only deleted two sentences from sec. 1 ('No m ore than one m em ber shall be a full-time Federal officer or em ployee. The rem aining m em bers shall not represent Executive agencies.'); the claim itself records that event in later_events as 'amendment of sec. 1, not an end'. Recording a partial amendment date as the clause's first end treats an amendment as an ending; and the same event then appears as a later_event dated on (not after) the first end.
